english.title: Landlord permit overcrowding of a dwelling
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the landlord of a dwelling at **(..SPECIFY ADDRESS..), permitted it to be overcrowded in that **(..SPECIFY NATURE OF OVERCROWDING ..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 331(1) and (3) of the Housing Act 1985.

english.notes: Section 331 - The landlordshall be deemed to cause or permit it to be overcrowded in the followingcircumstances, and not otherwise - (a) if he or a person effecting the letting onhis behalf had reasonable cause to believe that the dwelling would becomeovercrowded in circumstances rendering the occupier guilty of an offence;(b) ifhe or a person effecting the letting on his behalf failed to make inquiries ofthe proposed occupier as to the number, age and sex of the persons who would beallowed to sleep in the dwelling;(c) if notice is served on him or his agent bythe local housing authority that the dwelling is overcrowded in such circumstancesas to render the occupier guilty of an offence and he fails to take such stepsas are reasonably open to him for securing the abatement of the overcrowding,including if necessary legal proceedings for possession of the dwelling.
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant, being the landlord of a dwelling at **(..SPECIFY ADDRESS..), permitted it to be overcrowded in that **(..SPECIFY NATURE OF OVERCROWDING ..).

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding level two on the standard scale and, for every day subsequent to the date of conviction that the offence continues, to a fine not exceeding one-tenth of level two.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
